status: frozen source and algebra design before synthetic numerical results
scope: exact fixed-weight seven-read slope covariance coefficients; no observed pixel values or native FITS reads
source_ref: spacetelescope/hstcal 6a1147d7bdccb7e2a7b73af276f4597c6420fbb8, declared CALWF3 3.7.3, source-match not executable proof
gain: 1 electron per synthetic count solely as unit convention; coefficients retain arbitrary gain mapping
read_model: independent single-read N_i with Var=21^2/2; observed accumulated differences include shared -N_0, annihilated by intercept because sum(h)=0
poisson_model: independent cumulative electron increments with nonnegative total rate r; Cov(P_i,P_j)=r*min(t_i,t_j)
weights: u_i=abs((i-3)/3)^p, central 0^0=1; W_i=u_i/21^2; all seven sig_i nonzero and no rejection
reported_variance: 21^2/Q + r/T in electron-rate squared, Q=sum(u_i*(t_i-tbar_u)^2), T=300s; evaluate expected dy+ddg=r*T, not noisy realized span
exclusions: no correlated read/1f, IPC, persistence, nonlinearity, flat/dark reference uncertainty, cosmic-ray rejection, branch selection from noisy SNR or pixel-data inference
